en.headline: Business of Design Week opens with Switzerland as partner country
en.dek: The Hong Kong Design Centre’s annual event runs from 16 to 21 November under the theme Design in Dialogue, with the summit at HKCEC from 18 to 20 November.
body: Business of Design Week 2026 begins today, organised by the Hong Kong Design Centre with Switzerland as partner country for the first time.

The week-long programme, running until 21 November, carries the theme Design in Dialogue: Connect + Transform. Its flagship summit takes place from 18 to 20 November at the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre in Wan Chai, bringing together creative and business leaders.

According to the organisers, the event includes conferences, forums and related programmes across the city, drawing on Swiss approaches to design, innovation and collaboration while connecting with local initiatives such as DESIGN@HKG.
Admission and specific schedules vary by programme. Details are available from the Hong Kong Design Centre and the official event channels.

zh.headline: 設計營商周展開 瑞士首次出任伙伴國家
zh.dek: 香港設計中心主辦的年度盛事由16日至21日舉行，主題為「設計共話：從連繫到蛻變」，峰會18至20日在會展中心進行。
body: 設計營商周2026今日展開，由香港設計中心主辦，瑞士首次出任伙伴國家。
一連七日的活動至21日結束，主題為「設計共話：從連繫到蛻變」。旗艦峰會於18至20日在灣仔香港會議展覽中心舉行，匯聚創意及商業領袖。
主辦方表示，活動包括會議、論壇及遍布全城的相關節目，借鑑瑞士在設計、創新及協作方面的經驗，並與DESIGN@HKG等本地項目連繫。
各節目入場及時間安排不一，詳情可向香港設計中心及官方渠道查詢。
